title: Associative half-densities on symplectic groupoids and quantization
summary: In this paper, we study half-densities enhancing the multiplication map on a symplectic groupoid and which satisfy a suitable associativity condition. This is structurally motivated by the expected complete semiclassical-analytic approximation to a star product for the underlying Poisson manifold. We show the existence and classification of such associative half-densities, and further apply this theory to the understanding of semiclassical factors in Kontsevich's quantization formula.
